scientific_integrity: Proof is same-model reviewed, with exact integer verifier and exhaustive small-dimensional tests. General orbit enumeration is credited to Wei and Zou; the structural all-automorphism normalization is the assessed claim.
scientific_limitations: Rational automorphisms over F3 only; fails over F4 and is not asserted over extensions. Historic priority for equivalent cocycle terminology is not independently established.
title: Simultaneous permutation normalization of ternary perfect evolution algebras
